2.  **Spots per Giraffe:** While the exact number of spots varies by species (Reticulated, Masai, Southern, etc.) and individual, scientific literature and biological surveys typically estimate the number of dark markings on an adult giraffe to range between **200 and 400**. This figure respects the upper constraint of 41,000,000 while utilizing the midpoint of the defensible scientific range for spot density.
